engineOnly: Input fidelity

Separate up direction from jump; analog magnitude/flick detection, configurable tap jump and right-stick attacks. Replace shield+attack smash shortcut as default because shield+attack is a grab in Ultimate.
Reuses attacks, turns and grabs.
Canonical timing
One move-data source for startup/active/recovery, charge/hold and landing/autocancel windows. Reconcile 20/23 base-entry disagreements before locking timings.
Existing drawings can be retimed with metadata.
Buffer and cancel rules
Ultimate input buffer, short-hop aerial shortcut and damage behavior, run cancels, out-of-shield options, spot-dodge attack cancels, RAR/B-reverse and applicable specials.
Reuse action clips; add transition markers, not a bespoke sheet for every technique.
Collision fidelity
Multiple simultaneous moving hitboxes, per-body hurtboxes, shield pokes, clanks/trades, grabs and collision boundaries; attacks must not rely on artwork pixels.
Authored pose and socket metadata, with effect assets.
Air behavior
Full directional versus neutral air dodge, recovery lag/resource restoration, air acceleration/drift, fast fall, short/full hops and per-fighter recovery eligibility.
Uses listed airborne/dodge/helpless clips.
Defense fidelity
Shield-release parry, shield drop/shift, shieldstun/pushback, break/dizzy and dodge staling; configure forward/back roll separately.
Uses listed guard/dodge/break clips; effects separate.
Launch and damage fidelity
Verify Ultimate knockback, hitstun, hitlag, DI/SDI/launch-speed influence, rage/staling, crouch modifiers, armor and 1v1 damage rules against the chosen patch.
Mostly existing hit poses plus VFX.
Knockdown and ledges
Correct tech eligibility/windows, floor orientation, getup choice/timeout, trip sources, ledge snapping/regrabs/invulnerability/trumping and footstools.
Uses cataloged reaction/ledge clips.
Remove inherited defaults

Do not retain manual Melee L-cancel or the current fixed Melee-style wavedash as Ultimate behavior. Ultimate air-dodge landings and aerial autocancel need their own verified rules; avoid claiming Ultimate has no possible air-dodge slide.
No dedicated L-cancel sprite required.
World and modes
Stage geometry/collisions, items/hazards, stock/time rules and respawn. Six themes currently share one geometry; fighter art cannot supply stage parity.
Conditional stage/item tasks remain in the inventory.
Replication and determinism
Replicate action/phase, ground/air, victim orientation, item/weapon and attachment state. Handle hitlag, pause, interrupted moves and snapshot-skipped trigger frames.
Rendering follows authoritative simulation, never an unrelated wall clock.
Fighter-specific exceptions
Automatic turnaround, command inputs, extra jumps, crawl/wall-cling/tether, meters, stance changes and unique cancel systems are kit decisions for the original roster, not universal defaults.
Reuse or extend conditional animation families only after the kit is specified.
